representative.title: Restriction Digest of Plasmid DNA
representative.assay: DNA cutting, restriction mapping, and cloning
representative.operation: Restriction enzyme cleavage of purified plasmid DNA
representative.platform: standard molecular cloning bench workflow with optional agarose-gel readout
representative.methodVariant: enzyme- and buffer-system-specific digest; single or compatible double digest for mapping/cloning
representative.selectionNote: Selected as the core plasmid-DNA digest record because it is specific to restriction digestion, exposes an identifiable record and DOI, and is corroborated by Addgene and NEB resources. Enzyme, buffer, and substrate are retained as facets rather than mixed with ligation or Type IIS assembly.

screened.title: Restriction Digest
screened.reason: Direct repository workflow and useful corroboration, but the protocols.io record provides stronger record-level DOI and license metadata for the representative.

screened.title: Standard Protocol for Restriction Enzyme Digests
screened.reason: Authoritative manufacturer resource, but video-oriented and less metadata-rich than the selected stable record.

coverageGaps: Genomic-DNA digestion, methylation-sensitive mapping, and other substrate-specific workflows were not merged into the plasmid-DNA representative; consider child categories if those workflows are required.

representative.title: Ligation Protocol with T4 DNA Ligase
representative.operation: T4 DNA ligase joining of vector and insert DNA
representative.methodVariant: T4 DNA ligase; cohesive-end, blunt-end, and single-base-overhang ligation variants
representative.selectionNote: Selected as the core vector/insert ligation record because it is explicitly T4 DNA ligase-based, has a stable record URL, DOI, and record-level license evidence, and keeps cohesive-end, blunt-end, and single-base-overhang variants visible without merging in Type IIS or isothermal assembly.

screened.title: DNA Ligation
screened.reason: Direct repository companion for vector/insert ligation, retained for corroboration; the selected record has stronger DOI and license metadata.

screened.title: DNA Ligase Reaction Protocol
screened.reason: Authoritative manufacturer protocol for T4 DNA ligase, retained as a product-specific corroborating variant rather than the representative.

coverageGaps: Adapter ligation remains a separate variant per packet instructions and is not represented by the selected vector/insert record; suggested child category: adapter ligation.
Exact molar-ratio and end-repair optimization are source- and substrate-specific and were not normalized across records.

representative.title: Gibson Assembly Protocol (E5510)
representative.operation: Isothermal assembly of overlapping DNA fragments into a linearized vector
representative.specimen: purified overlapping DNA fragments and linearized vector
representative.methodVariant: classic Gibson assembly; 2-3 and 4-6 fragment designs with overlap-length and fragment-count facets
representative.selectionNote: Selected as the classic Gibson/isothermal representative because it is a manufacturer-authored protocol with a unique E5510 record, DOI, direct record PDF, explicit record-level license evidence, and clear overlap-design and fragment-count facets. NEBuilder HiFi is retained as a related but distinct isothermal variant.

screened.title: Gibson Assembly Protocol (E5510)
screened.reason: Official manufacturer landing page corroborating the selected record; protocols.io was preferred for DOI and record-level license metadata.

coverageGaps: NEBuilder HiFi and other commercial isothermal assembly chemistries are related variants and were not collapsed into the classic Gibson representative; split by kit chemistry if kit-level catalog coverage is needed.
PCR cleanup, transformation, and colony screening are downstream workflows and were not merged into this assembly category.

representative.title: Golden Gate Assembly Protocol for NEB Golden Gate Assembly Mix
representative.operation: One-pot Type IIS restriction and ligation assembly of modular DNA parts
representative.specimen: precloned DNA parts and destination plasmid
representative.methodVariant: BsaI-HFv2 and T4 DNA ligase Golden Gate mix; enzyme cycling and modular cloning part assembly
representative.selectionNote: Selected as the Golden Gate representative because it is a direct Type IIS modular-assembly record with identifiable record and DOI metadata, explicit record-level license evidence, and visible enzyme-cycling and part-assembly facets. It is kept separate from restriction-only digestion, T4 ligation, and Gibson/isothermal assembly.

screened.title: Golden Gate Assembly Protocol Using PaqCI (NEB R0745) and T4 DNA Ligase (NEB M0202)
screened.reason: Valid Type IIS assembly variant, but PaqCI-specific cycling was retained separately from the selected BsaI-based Golden Gate record.

screened.title: Transformation Protocol for Using NEB Golden Gate Assembly Mix
screened.reason: Downstream transformation protocol rather than the Golden Gate assembly reaction itself.

coverageGaps: Part standards such as MoClo and other Type IIS domestication schemes were not merged; suggested child category: part-standard-specific Golden Gate.
Other Type IIS enzymes such as PaqCI and SapI were screened as variants rather than combined with the BsaI representative.

selfCheckNotes: Category IDs match the packet exactly and remain in assignment order.
Each representative has a stable HTTPS source URL, source record ID or DOI, and record-level license evidence URL.
Restriction digestion, T4 ligation, Gibson/isothermal assembly, and Golden Gate/Type IIS assembly remain separate category records.
Metadata-only output: no protocol instructions, tables, figures, videos, PDFs, or long source passages were copied into the result.

runNotes: Completed focused collection across the four assigned molecular-DNA-assembly categories.
Public source scope included direct protocols.io records plus corroborating Addgene and New England Biolabs resources.
Coverage gaps are explicit for adapter ligation, substrate-specific restriction workflows, commercial isothermal chemistries, and Type IIS part standards.
